comment.comment:
I've been holding $MASK for weeks now and every day of this stretch closed above $4.2M. Consistent, every day lol

From Oct 27 to Nov 3 it did ~$37M in volume (~$4.6M a day), $131.4M since Oct 1, ~$183K in platform fees this stretch and $658.5K in total.

On top of that $331K got bought back and burned across 7 buybacks, 3.65% of the total supply is gone, and 1,728 ZEC (~$2.3M) went out to $MASK holders.

If you're new, NullMask is pretty much a privacy pool that runs inside the wallet you already use. You deposit, withdraw to a fresh address, and zero-knowledge proofs break the direct link between the two. Every deposit gets screened first, so flagged funds get refused.

Zcash keeps its privacy on its own chain, NullMask just went live on Avalanche as chain #6 next to Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain and Solana, with Monad and Arbitrum next.

They also shipped NullMask Pay, where you send a link and get paid straight into your private balance, NullMask Exchange powered by PancakeSwap, and a Beldex partnership that brings shielded transfers and swaps to BDX on BNB Chain.

Points Season One is already at 20K+ wallets with a counted withdrawal and $46.3M in withdrawals earning points, and now holding earns too, 1 point per $100 per day on your pool balance.

As if that wasn't enough, the team keeps showing up on air, Privacy Is Back Ep 5 with Avalanche and Spectre AI, Ep 6 with Monad and Zebec, plus MCG and Balance's Market Manifesto Ep 28.

Still so early on this one imo

comment.comment:
$ORBIO | Two Builders. Two Use Cases. One Bigger Opportunity. 🪐

I've been following @orbiodotso closely, and the latest developments reveal another interesting chapter.

We're starting to see more examples of what people can actually build on top of Orbio.

1. Orbancy: 100 AI trader clones.
@Orbancyio has launched The Arena, featuring 100 AI agents modeled on the onchain histories of FOMO's top traders.

Each receives $10,000 in simulated capital and makes AI-driven trading decisions using live Robinhood Chain prices.

It's paper trading, not real capital management. But it's a fascinating experiment in autonomous decision-making.

2. Slop Cash: AI-powered code review.
@SlopCash announced that its free code-review assistant, Slopbot, is moving toward Orbio's inference gateway.

A private security-review program for Orbio's contracts is also planned.

Both initiatives still need to demonstrate real results.

But look at the difference between these applications.

One explores autonomous trading.

The other focuses on developer tools and security.

Different products. Different audiences. A potential shared intelligence infrastructure.
Meanwhile, Orbio's metrics continue advancing.

November 1 → November 5:
• AI tokens served: 196.7B → 269.2B (+36.9%)
• Protocol fees collected: $473K → $486.9K
• API usage: $69.1K → $73.5K
• Agents launched: 2,215 → 2,243

HolderScan now reports 15,800 $ORBIO holders, up 292 over seven days.

Market cap: approximately $29.7M.

The technical growth is impressive, but usage alone isn't the final proof.
What matters next is whether these applications generate recurring, paid demand for inference.

That's the transition I'm watching.

From building infrastructure to becoming infrastructure that other builders genuinely depend on.
I'm still holding $ORBIO.

The opportunity remains exciting. The economics still need to prove themselves.

And that's exactly why I'm continuing to follow this story. 🪐

Data: Orbio Analytics, Orbancy, Slop Cash and HolderScan | November 5, 2026.
